jobs.title: Studentische Aushilfe in freier Mitarbeit – Redaktion DER TAG
jobs.reason: This is a studentische Aushilfe / freie Mitarbeit — a student side-role explicitly requiring current enrolment, which is excluded by policy. It is also unrelated to the candidate's research and policy interests.

jobs.title: Zwei Studentische Teilzeitkräfte Internet (w/m/d/k.A.)
jobs.reason: This is an explicitly student side-role (Studentische Teilzeitkraft) requiring current enrolment at a German university, which is excluded by policy. It is also a communications/web-editing role that requires ongoing German enrolment the candidate (at LSE) does not hold.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow Klima (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: The posting requires at least five years of relevant professional experience as an essential, plus an established political network and policy-advisory track record — well beyond the candidate's student-assistant profile. Although DGAP and the climate/foreign-policy focus are in a strong interest zone, the experience requirement is a hard disqualifier.

jobs.title: Fundraising Manager (m/w/d) für Testamentsspenden
jobs.reason: Ineligible — a Manager title requiring 3–5 years of professional experience in fundraising and marketing, which the candidate (student-assistant experience only) clearly lacks. The role is also a fundraising/marketing specialism outside the candidate's research and policy focus.

jobs.title: Bote/Botin, Pförtner:in, Postverteiler:in (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: This is a mailroom / porter / courier service role requiring prior experience in a post-room and a Class B driving licence, with duties entirely clerical-logistical. It has no research, policy, or analytical content and does not match the candidate's profile or interest zones on any axis.

jobs.title: Initiativbewerbung Praktikum Redaktion (Pflicht- & freiwilliges Praktikum) (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: This is an internship (Praktikum), and moreover a speculative Initiativbewerbung with no concrete vacancy — excluded as a matter of policy. The editorial research work would otherwise be of moderate interest, but the internship framing is a hard disqualifier.

jobs.title: Initiativbewerbung Volontariat - Redaktion (m/w/d)
jobs.reason: This is a paid 18-month journalism traineeship (Volontariat, not an internship or Werkstelle), so it is eligible and genuinely entry-level, and the candidate's research and writing skills plus published work transfer reasonably. However, it is a dedicated journalism-training path outside the candidate's three core zones, and the emphasis on prior publicistic work, podcasts and social-media editing is only a partial fit, keeping interest and priority modest.

jobs.title: Event Manager (gn)
jobs.reason: Ineligible on two hard grounds: it requires three or more years of professional event-management experience (well beyond the candidate's student-assistant background) and it is a Manager-level role with team leadership. It also demands a professional qualification in event management, which the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Projektleitung (m/w/d) Standortverlagerung
jobs.reason: This is a project-lead role requiring demonstrable project-management leadership experience ("Nachweisliche Projektleitungserfahrungen"), a leadership-level title, and relevant vocational training — none of which the candidate's student-assistant background meets. It is an office-relocation logistics role entirely outside the candidate's research and policy interests.

jobs.title: rbb young reporter 2026
jobs.reason: This is a youth-trainee programme for people who have completed year 10 and are no older than 19, essentially a student/apprentice scheme with an unpaid initial phase — it is not a genuine paid professional role for the candidate. It also sits far outside the candidate's academic and policy-research profile.
jobs.salary: Not specified (initial phase unpaid; later work honoured)

jobs.title: Auftragsarbeit für die ökonomische Modellierung von Waldprojekten
jobs.reason: This is a specialist consultancy contract requiring deep forestry economics, forest carbon MRV expertise, and knowledge of specific certification standards (EU CRCF, Verra, WKS, ISO 14064-2) plus cost-benefit and break-even financial modelling — an essential expert competency the candidate plainly lacks. It is a niche environmental/carbon-market commission entirely outside the candidate's academic and skills profile.

jobs.title: Studentischer Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) Klimaschutz & Energiepolitik
jobs.reason: This is a Werkstudent (working-student) position, which is excluded by policy regardless of fit. The climate/energy-policy topic also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Praktikum im Unterstützungsvorhaben für die Umsetzung des Pariser Klimaschutzabkommens (SPA)
jobs.reason: This is explicitly an internship (Praktikum) requiring current enrolment or a degree completed no more than 6 months prior, which is a policy-excluded role type regardless of pay. The climate-policy subject is adjacent to the candidate's interests but the internship classification is a hard disqualifier.

jobs.title: Sachbearbeiter*in (w/m/d) für den Arbeitskreis III „Gesundheit, Bildung & Lebensweise" in Teilzeit
jobs.reason: The role is an entry-to-junior administrative/project-support post the candidate could plausibly hold (research, event organisation, funding administration — the latter mirroring the German Rectors' Conference work), so it is a real paper fit though heavily weighted toward finance/controlling and public-relations tasks that are only a partial match. The subject area (health, education, lifestyle policy) sits outside the candidate's core interest zones, and the role is administrative rather than research-driven, which holds the score down. It is eligible and winnable but not a compelling target.
